程序包 com.badlogic.gdx.graphics.g3d.particles

类 ParticleControllerComponent

java.lang.Object
com.badlogic.gdx.graphics.g3d.particles.ParticleControllerComponent
所有已实现的接口:
ResourceData.Configurable, com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Disposable, com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Json.Serializable
直接已知子类:
Emitter, Influencer, ParticleControllerRenderer
public abstract class ParticleControllerComponent extends Object implements com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Disposable, com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Json.Serializable, ResourceData.Configurable
It's the base class of every ParticleController component. A component duty is to participate in one or some events during the simulation. (i.e it can handle the particles emission or modify particle properties, etc.).
